evals.prompt:
i need a typed event emitter for my app. it should be generic so different parts of the system can define their own event maps. needs to support async listeners, wildcard listeners, and once-off listeners. also want type safety so you cant emit an event with the wrong payload.

oh and make it testable please
evals.expected_output: A generic TypedEventEmitter<EventMap> class with: type-safe emit/on/off/once, async listener support, wildcard pattern, injectable or mockable design, proper generics that enforce payload types per event name
expectations: Generic class/interface parameterized by an event map type (e.g., TypedEventEmitter<EventMap>)

Design allows dependency injection or mocking for tests
